# Luigui Herrera

Educational tools for investors, personal finance, investor protection, market context and quantitative research.

## What this site is
Luigui Herrera provides educational tools to organize personal finance, debt, investor diagnostics, market regime context, statistical levels, investment-protection checklists, market reports and quantitative research.

## Important limits
This site is educational and informational. It does not provide personalized investment, legal, tax or financial advice. It does not promise returns and does not issue buy/sell signals.
